verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments platform, so a user-defined event-to-action rules engine is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack does not document any such rules or automation feature. Recurring and scheduled charges (kushki-docs-29, kushki-docs-30) are time-based schedules, not event-triggered rules. Card-present webhooks (kushki-docs-34) are outbound notifications, not user-defined rules that trigger actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
